title: feat: one label list for issues and pull requests
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
The issue/PR classifier has returned 403 on every run since ~July 22 (`openai-large` isn't allowed on its key) and still exited green, so new PRs went unlabeled and the Support and Dev projects stopped receiving issues.

- Switch the classifier to `gpt-5.6-luna` (the app pre-review already uses it with the same key) and exit non-zero when classification or a GitHub write fails
- Use one label list for issues and PRs, defined in `operations/github/project-manager.md`: one kind (`MODEL`, `ECONOMICS`, `MONITORING`, `APPS`, `INFRA`, `UI-UX`, `API`, `DOCS`), at most one type (`BUG`, `FEATURE`, `QUESTION`, `OUTAGE`, `TRACKING`) and flags (`BILLING`, `SECURITY`, `AUTOMATED`, plus `POLLEN-QUEST` on PRs only). The classifier picks every label; the script only passes it the changed files, the author's account type and the linked issues' labels
- Stop adding PRs to the Dev project. Issue routing (Support, Dev, Apps, paid-customer priority) is unchanged
- Add a `workflow_dispatch` that re-classifies existing issues and PRs (dry run by default) and drop the old backfill script

GitHub labels are already migrated: `DEV-*` and Support's type/service labels were renamed or merged into the list above, and the retired ones (`IMAGE`, `TEXT`, `AUDIO`, `VIDEO`, `WEB`, `CREDITS`, `ACCOUNT`, `.REQUEST`, `.INTEGRATION`, `.DOCS`, `DEV-CHORE`, `refactor`, `EPIC`) were deleted. Open issues and PRs were relabeled from this branch: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/actions/runs/35869156178

The app publish, Polli auto-fix and quest reward flows only read `APP-*`, `POLLI` and issue `POLLEN-QUEST` labels, which are unchanged.

gist.headline: The label garden regrows
gist.blurb: The GitHub sorter has fresh pollen and a single, less mysterious label basket. New issues can find Support, Dev, and Apps again instead of quietly becoming decorative metadata.
gist.summary: Replaced the failing `openai-large` issue/PR classifier with `gpt-5.6-luna`, made classification and GitHub write failures exit non-zero, and consolidated issue and PR labeling into one documented kind/type/flag taxonomy with a dry-run reclassification workflow.
gist.impact: Contributors and maintainers get reliably labeled new issues and PRs again, with existing issue routing to Support, Dev, Apps, and paid-customer priority preserved while PRs no longer enter the Dev project.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy GitHub triage garden: Polli acts as a careful gardener sorting one tidy basket of labeled seed packets into clearly marked Support, Dev, and Apps paths. A friendly CRT monitor robot verifies the routes on a terminal, while code-vines and flowers represent issues being correctly classified instead of lost in the weeds.
